lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Anchor forty-four. Two hundred and sixty megawatts. Sable Reach holds the deck and the ring is engaged from the far side.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Engaged from the far side. Somebody opened this one and did not close it, and it has been open for eleven hours.

lines.speaker: ferrar
lines.text: Yolanda. I'm going to talk fast and you're going to let me, because I've spent everything I had getting to this deck first.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Talk.

lines.speaker: ferrar
lines.text: I sold four keys. Three went to mining consortia. The fourth went to the office that briefed you, and they have opened it, and I want it shut.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Shut it with what? You need the bindstone and a live bus and about six hours.

lines.speaker: ferrar
lines.text: I need the ring to stay powered and everything coming through it to die on the deck. That's your whole job, Captain. I'm not even asking you to change it.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Contact. Reach elements — and they are firing away from you.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: His people are on our line.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Some of his people. The rest are the ones the office bought. They're shooting at each other and at us and it is very hard to score.

lines.speaker: ferrar
lines.text: Keep the bus up. Whatever else you do, Captain, keep the bus up — if the ring drops while it's engaged the far side doesn't close, it *stays*.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: He's right. I hate it, but the arithmetic is his.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Then we hold the bus and we hold the deck.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Vasquez — the far side is drawing on us. Not the crews. The anchor itself is reading load we aren't spending.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: How much?

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: It's rising.
lines.beat: first appearance of Act III's mechanic, one act early, with no explanation

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Over capacity. Shed something now — if the ring browns out with a threshold up we do not get to try again.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: One through. Ring is holding.

lines.speaker: ferrar
lines.text: Captain. If you're going to lose this, tell me now while I can still do something stupid.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Deck is clear. Ring remains engaged.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Ferrar's at the bindstone. He's been at it since the eighth wave.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Ferrar. Can you shut it?

lines.speaker: ferrar
lines.text: No. It's not bound to anywhere I can name. It isn't a door any more — it's an opening.
lines.beat: he fails, and he is the one who understood it first

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Control, log this. The far side of anchor forty-four has no bind key and it is drawing power.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Logged. Meridian Actual has no guidance at this time.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: No. I don't imagine it does.
